hero:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: 16:9 wide editorial hero background for a Japanese technical article about cautiously rolling out a local Rust prerelease scanner to multiple repositories.
Primary request: Draw a refined hand-painted editorial illustration of a calm software inspection workshop. Small abstract unmarked repository cases move along two gently diverging inspection routes, one with muted teal open gate shapes, one with warm coral paused gate shapes. Show deliberate inspection, not dramatic danger or speed. The objects are tactile wood and matte ceramic, with restrained ink outlines and soft watercolor grain. A single warm desk lamp may illuminate the route.
Composition: 16:9 landscape. Keep the top 42 percent quiet plain warm ivory negative space for a later typographic title. The detailed scene lives across the lower-left and lower-center. Keep the bottom-right quarter quiet for a pair of mascots which will be composited later. No border. Balanced spacious composition, mature Japanese technical editorial, beautifully finished.
Color palette: warm ivory background #F5F1E8, deep ink navy #182D3D, muted teal #3E887F, warm coral #D9826B. Soft warm neutral shadows.
Text: none. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels or faux writing anywhere.
Avoid: no cats, no animals, no people, no real logos, no Rust gear logo, no brand marks, no watermarks, no pseudo-code, no arrows with labels, no giant dashboard.

illustration:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: text-free body illustration for a Japanese technical article about a scanner passing empty-input checks but pausing real content.
Primary request: A calm hand-painted editorial illustration of two adjacent miniature inspection lanes on a warm wood workbench. On the left, an entirely empty cream tray passes through a simple muted teal open inspection arch with a softly lit round green indicator. On the right, a second tray carrying blank cream papers and a small unmarked wooden repository case is stopped before a lowered coral gate; a small magnifying glass beside the papers suggests careful review. The populated tray must clearly be unable to pass the closed gate. This is a tangible visual metaphor for empty checks versus content checks, not an actual software user interface.
Composition: wide 16:9, three-quarter view, focus only on the two lanes and trays, clean ivory background, all key objects fully in frame, generous breathing room. No titles or captions. Clearly distinguish empty left tray from loaded right tray.
Style: refined watercolor and fine ink editorial illustration, tactile matte ceramic and wood, subtle paper grain, soft neutral shadows, warm Japanese magazine quality. Same visual family as a handcrafted scanner workshop.
Color palette: warm ivory #F5F1E8, deep ink navy #182D3D, muted teal #3E887F, warm coral #D9826B.
Text: absolutely none. Blank papers with no writing or lines. No letters, digits, code, words, logos or watermarks.
Avoid: people, animals, cats, real logos, speed effects, threat imagery, explosions, data claims, arrows or captions.
